title: Microorganism of elemental sulfur autotrophic partial denitrification
description: Heterotrophic partial denitrification has recently been recognized as an efficient nitrite supply technology for anaerobic ammonia oxidation, but it cannot eliminate the requirement for organic carbon. In this project, six elemental sulfur-packed bed reactors were operated under high pH and free ammonia conditions to achieve elmental partial denitrification without organic carbon requirement.
samples: MIMS Environmental/Metagenome sample from sludge metagenome
environmental sample; urban association not established
